description:
Use this when the user wants the sound of a clip changed: "mute the original audio", "turn my voice up",
        "remove the background noise", "even out the volume", "make me sound like a robot", "the music is too loud".
        clip_id: from list_clips. original_volume 0-1000 (percent, 100 = as recorded); mute_original; denoise 0-100
        (background noise removal); voice_boost 0-100 (clearer speech); normalize (even loudness); voice_effect: a
        voice filter by name (robot, deep, chipmunk, echo, telephone, megaphone, radio, cave...) or off; music_volume:
        quiet, normal, loud or a percent 0-400 (100 = the usual level under speech); music_ducking (the music dips
        while someone talks); ducking_db 0-30 (how far it dips).
        Not for: adding or changing the song (edit_clip music) or sound effects at a moment (add_to_clip). Saved as an
        undoable version (undo_edit). Costs no Horizon Units. Returns job_id: poll job_status, then
        get_download_link. Options the account can't use are refused by name before anything changes.
name: mix_audio
title: Mix the sound
